meta.units: millimetres (mm), grams (g), milliampere-hours (mAh), volts (V), watt-hours (Wh), gigahertz (GHz)

crs.y: front elevation, 0 at the top edge, + downward toward the grips
crs.z: depth, 0 at the face plane, + toward the viewer, - into the body

meta.note: Every asserted value carries a confidence code (V verified, E estimated, U unknown) and a source id. Estimates are photogrammetric (+/-4%) unless noted. This is an atlas-grade model, not CAD.

entities.label: DualSense Wireless Controller
entities.summary: Sony's PS5-era wireless controller: two-tone shell, two voice-coil haptic actuators, adaptive triggers, a 2-point clickable touchpad, RGB light bar and USB-C/Bluetooth 5.1 connectivity.

props.note: base model; CFI-ZCT1WA is the A revision
y axis, top edge to grip tips
z axis, face to rear of grips

entities.label: Arctic White
entities.summary: Arctic White colourway. launch colourway: matte white shell, black core and black controls.

entities.label: Midnight Black
entities.summary: Midnight Black colourway. all-black colourway: black shell, black core, black controls.

entities.label: Cosmic Red
entities.summary: Cosmic Red colourway. deep red shell with black core.

entities.label: Cobalt Blue
entities.summary: Cobalt Blue colourway. blue shell with black core.

entities.label: DualSense Edge (sibling, not modelled)
entities.summary: Pro-grade sibling released 2023 with replaceable stick modules, back paddles, trigger stops and profiles. Deliberately excluded from this model so dimensions are never conflated.

entities.label: Shell & Surfaces
entities.summary: Two-tone outer shell, black core plate, touchpad, face surfaces and cosmetic details.

entities.label: Input & Controls
entities.summary: Sticks, d-pad, face buttons, system buttons and the touch surface.

entities.label: Triggers & Shoulders
entities.summary: L1/R1 bumpers and the two motorised adaptive trigger modules.

entities.label: Haptics
entities.summary: Two voice-coil linear actuators, one in each palm grip.

entities.label: Audio
entities.summary: Mono speaker, dual-microphone array and 3.5 mm headset jack.

entities.label: Power
entities.summary: LIP1708 lithium-ion pack, USB-C charging and dock contacts.

entities.label: Connectivity & Compute
entities.summary: Main PCB, Bluetooth 5.1 radio, antenna and the 6-axis IMU.

entities.label: Lighting
entities.summary: Two RGB light-bar diffusers, five player LEDs and the mute LED.

entities.label: Structure & Fasteners
entities.summary: Midframe, clips, screws and the tool-less trim architecture.

entities.label: Identity & Compliance
entities.summary: Model numbers, regulatory IDs, labels and standards.

entities.label: Outer shell assembly
entities.summary: Front and rear shells, touchpad stack, speaker grille and cosmetic label.

entities.label: Black core assembly
entities.summary: The black core plate and the control cluster seated in it.

entities.label: Control assembly
entities.summary: Sticks, d-pad, face buttons and system buttons.

entities.label: Trigger assembly (per side)
entities.summary: Removable module: trigger paddle, motor, gear train, stopper, spring and position sensor.

entities.label: Haptic assembly
entities.summary: Two voice-coil actuators and their wiring.

entities.label: Audio assembly
entities.summary: Speaker, microphone array and headset jack.

entities.label: Power assembly
entities.summary: Battery, bracket, USB-C port and charging contacts.

entities.label: Main board assembly
entities.summary: BDM-0xx main PCB, radio, antenna and IMU.

entities.label: Lighting assembly
entities.summary: Light guides, player LED strip and mute LED.

entities.label: Fasteners & frame
entities.summary: Midframe, external and internal screws, clips.

entities.label: Front shell
entities.summary: Injection-moulded upper shell: the white outer skin on launch colourways, carrying the core aperture, stick wells and button seats. The rear-facing lower half is modelled as the rear shell.

props.note: typical for this class of shell

entities.label: Rear shell
entities.summary: The black lower shell. It closes the body, carries the microtexture grip, the specification label, reset pinhole and four external screws.

entities.label: Black core plate
entities.summary: The gloss-black face plate that surrounds the sticks and carries the PS, mute and speaker details. It is the visual signature of the two-tone design.

entities.label: Core gasket
entities.summary: Thin elastomer gasket under the core plate, sealing the seam and damping rattle.

entities.label: Midframe
entities.summary: Internal chassis that locates the main PCB, trigger modules and battery. It is revealed after the rear shell and tool-less trim are removed.

entities.label: Touchpad bezel
entities.summary: Black bezel surrounding the touchpad, recessing it into the shell and hiding the light-guide gap.

entities.label: Touchpad
entities.summary: 2-point capacitive touch surface with mechanical click; on the white colourway it is a white plate, slightly textured and low-gloss.

entities.label: Touchpad flex
entities.summary: Flexible printed circuit carrying the capacitive sensor grid and click switch to the main board.

entities.label: Touchpad click switch
entities.summary: Dome/tact switch under the touchpad giving the pad its click input.

entities.label: Light bar - left diffuser
entities.summary: Translucent light guide along the left edge of the touchpad. Two of these replace the single DualShock 4 bar.

entities.label: Light bar - right diffuser
entities.summary: Translucent light guide along the right edge of the touchpad, mirroring the left strip.

entities.label: Player LED strip
entities.summary: Diffuser strip with five white LEDs just below the touchpad, showing player slot 1-4 and off.

entities.label: Mute LED
entities.summary: Amber LED integrated into the mute button, indicating hardware microphone mute.

entities.label: Speaker grille
entities.summary: Nine small perforations in two staggered rows (5 + 4) above the PS button, letting the mono speaker out.

entities.label: Speaker
entities.summary: Mono controller speaker behind the grille, used for in-game audio and system sounds.

entities.label: Microphone array
entities.summary: Two MEMS microphones: one on the main PCB, one on a separate flex near the battery, forming the built-in array used for chat and noise rejection.

entities.label: 3.5 mm headset jack
entities.summary: CTIA TRRS jack on the bottom edge, carrying stereo audio and microphone for a wired headset.

entities.label: Specification label
entities.summary: Rear label carrying model, serial, FCC/IC IDs, charging input, manufacturer and regulatory marks.

entities.label: Reset pinhole
entities.summary: Pinhole button next to the SONY logo on the rear; hold 5 s to reset the controller.

entities.label: Grip microtexture
entities.summary: About 40,000 moulded PlayStation-symbol shapes (triangle, circle, cross, square) stacked in 3D across the lower shell, with the largest symbols about 0.5 mm wide.

entities.label: Analog stick module - left
entities.summary: Spring-centred 2-axis gimbal with a potentiometer per axis, L3 click and a dished rubber cap. Same class of module as DualShock 4.

entities.label: Stick cap - left
entities.summary: Dished rubber thumb cap, about 19 mm across, with a moulded knurled rim for grip.

entities.label: Analog stick module - right
entities.summary: Spring-centred 2-axis gimbal with a potentiometer per axis, L3 click and a dished rubber cap. Same class of module as DualShock 4.

entities.label: Stick cap - right
entities.summary: Dished rubber thumb cap, about 19 mm across, with a moulded knurled rim for grip.

entities.label: D-pad
entities.summary: Digital directional pad: four separate translucent caps in a cross-shaped black recess. Digital only - no analog pressure.

entities.label: D-pad up key
entities.summary: Individual d-pad key with a rounded, tapered cap and white direction arrow.

entities.label: D-pad down key
entities.summary: Individual d-pad key with a rounded, tapered cap and white direction arrow.

entities.label: D-pad left key
entities.summary: Individual d-pad key with a rounded, tapered cap and white direction arrow.

entities.label: D-pad right key
entities.summary: Individual d-pad key with a rounded, tapered cap and white direction arrow.

entities.label: Triangle button
entities.summary: Clear/smoke translucent triangle cap with a white symbol, over a conductive-rubber dome. Monochrome face buttons are a DualSense signature.

entities.label: Circle button
entities.summary: Clear/smoke translucent circle cap with a white symbol, over a conductive-rubber dome. Monochrome face buttons are a DualSense signature.

entities.label: Cross button
entities.summary: Clear/smoke translucent cross cap with a white symbol, over a conductive-rubber dome. Monochrome face buttons are a DualSense signature.

entities.label: Square button
entities.summary: Clear/smoke translucent square cap with a white symbol, over a conductive-rubber dome. Monochrome face buttons are a DualSense signature.

entities.label: Create button
entities.summary: Pill button with a three-line capture icon. Replaces the DualShock 4 Share button; captures screenshots and clips.

entities.label: Options button
entities.summary: Pill button with a three-line menu icon, opening in-game options.

entities.label: PS button
entities.summary: Round PS monogram button below the touchpad. Wakes the console, opens the home screen and, with Create, enters Bluetooth pairing.

entities.label: Mute button
entities.summary: Hardware microphone mute pill with an integrated amber LED, below the PS button.

entities.label: L1 bumper
entities.summary: Left shoulder button, a hinged lever over a conductive-rubber contact.

entities.label: R1 bumper
entities.summary: Right shoulder button, mirroring L1.

entities.label: L2 adaptive trigger
entities.summary: Analog trigger paddle with programmable resistance generated by a dedicated motor and gear train. 'Adaptive Triggers' is Sony's marketing name.

entities.label: R2 adaptive trigger
entities.summary: Analog trigger paddle with programmable resistance generated by a dedicated motor and gear train. 'Adaptive Triggers' is Sony's marketing name.

entities.label: Trigger motor - left
entities.summary: Small DC rotary motor in the trigger module; through the gear train it presses a stopper into the trigger path to create programmable resistance.

entities.label: Trigger motor - right
entities.summary: Small DC rotary motor in the trigger module; through the gear train it presses a stopper into the trigger path to create programmable resistance.

entities.label: Trigger gear train
entities.summary: Multi-stage gear train from the motor pinion to a cam/rack that sets the stopper position. 'Worm gear' is common teardown shorthand, not a Sony term.

entities.label: Trigger stopper / lever
entities.summary: Lever pressed into the trigger's rotation path by the gear train; its position sets the resistance curve felt at the fingertip.

entities.label: Trigger return spring
entities.summary: Return spring restoring the trigger and providing the baseline feel when no adaptive force is commanded.

entities.label: Trigger position sensor
entities.summary: Position-sensing element reporting analog trigger travel to the main board. Exact encoder type is not public.

entities.label: Voice-coil actuator - left
entities.summary: Linear voice-coil actuator in the palm grip, replacing the eccentric-mass rumble motor. Two channels give the DualSense its wide-band haptics.

entities.label: Voice-coil actuator - right
entities.summary: Linear voice-coil actuator in the palm grip, replacing the eccentric-mass rumble motor. Two channels give the DualSense its wide-band haptics.

entities.label: Haptic wiring
entities.summary: Four soldered wires linking the two voice-coil actuators to the main board.

entities.label: Battery LIP1708
entities.summary: 1560 mAh lithium-ion pouch cell, 3.65 V nominal (about 5.7 Wh), held in a screwed bracket.

entities.label: Battery bracket
entities.summary: Metal-reinforced bracket retaining the battery with one 6.5 mm Phillips screw.

entities.label: Charging contacts
entities.summary: Gold-plated contacts on the bottom edge for the charging dock; three pins visible.

entities.label: USB-C port
entities.summary: USB Type-C receptacle on the top edge for charging (5 V / 1.5 A) and wired data.

entities.label: Main PCB (BDM-0xx)
entities.summary: Main logic board carrying the Bluetooth SoC, IMU, audio codec, LED drivers and all flex connectors. Revisions run BDM-010 through BDM-050.

entities.label: Bluetooth 5.1 radio
entities.summary: 2.4 GHz Bluetooth 5.1 radio (2402-2480 MHz), FCC equipment class DSS. Chipset identity is not public and varies by board revision.

entities.label: Bluetooth antenna
entities.summary: 2.4 GHz antenna on/near the main board. Type (PCB trace vs chip) is not public; the FCC antenna exhibit is confidential.

entities.label: 6-axis IMU
entities.summary: 3-axis accelerometer plus 3-axis gyroscope, soldered to the main PCB; provides tilt and motion sensing.

entities.label: External screws
entities.summary: Four 6.4-6.5 mm Phillips screws closing the rear shell: two at the bottom corners, two behind the bumpers.

entities.label: Internal screws
entities.summary: Midframe and trigger-module screws: 4 midframe plus 2 per trigger assembly; 3+1 inside each trigger module.

entities.label: Player LEDs (5)
entities.summary: Five white LEDs behind the diffuser, indicating player slot 1-4 and off.

entities.label: Left stick (X/Y + L3)
entities.summary: Two-axis spring-centred analog stick with full-travel L3 click. The PS5 host reports 8-bit axis values; internal resolution is not published.

entities.label: Right stick (X/Y + R3)
entities.summary: Two-axis analog stick with R3 click; same module class as the left stick.

entities.label: L2 adaptive trigger
entities.summary: Analog left trigger whose resistance is programmable via a motor and gear train. Travel about 10-12 mm / 25-35 degrees; maximum force is not public.

entities.label: R2 adaptive trigger
entities.summary: Analog right trigger with programmable resistance.

entities.label: L1 bumper
entities.summary: Digital left shoulder button.

entities.label: R1 bumper
entities.summary: Digital right shoulder button.

entities.label: D-pad
entities.summary: Four digital direction buttons in a cross; discrete caps, not a rocking disc.

entities.label: Face buttons (triangle/circle/cross/square)
entities.summary: Four digital action buttons in a diamond, monochrome with white symbols.

entities.label: Touchpad input
entities.summary: 2-point capacitive touch surface plus a mechanical click. Tracks one or two fingers and reports absolute position.

entities.label: PS button
entities.summary: Home / wake / pairing button below the touchpad.

entities.label: Create button
entities.summary: Capture and broadcast entry point; replaced the DualShock 4 Share button.

entities.label: Options button
entities.summary: Digital menu button.

entities.label: Mute button
entities.summary: Hardware microphone mute toggle with LED state.

entities.label: Haptic feedback
entities.summary: Two-channel, wide-band vibrotactile feedback rendered by voice-coil actuators instead of binary rumble motors. Games stream a haptic signal that can represent textures, impacts and recoil.

entities.label: Adaptive triggers
entities.summary: Each trigger's resistance is a programmable function of travel, generated mechanically by a per-trigger motor and gear train pressing a stopper into the trigger path.

entities.label: Touchpad
entities.summary: 2-point capacitive touch surface with click, flanked by the two light-bar strips.

entities.label: Hardware mute
entities.summary: Dedicated microphone mute button that cuts capture in hardware, with its own LED.

entities.label: RGB light bar
entities.summary: Two RGB diffuser strips flanking the touchpad; used as player colour and for in-game effects.

entities.label: Player indicator
entities.summary: Five white LEDs below the touchpad show player slot 1-4 or off.

entities.label: Motion sensing
entities.summary: 6-axis motion sensing: 3-axis accelerometer plus 3-axis gyroscope.

entities.label: Create / capture
entities.summary: Screenshot and video-clip capture, plus the broadcast entry point.

entities.label: Headset audio
entities.summary: Stereo audio and microphone over a 3.5 mm CTIA headset jack.

entities.label: Built-in speaker
entities.summary: Mono speaker for in-game and system audio.

entities.label: Built-in microphone array
entities.summary: Two-microphone array for chat without a headset, with hardware mute.

entities.label: Bluetooth 5.1
entities.summary: Wireless link using Bluetooth 5.1 (2402-2480 MHz), up to four stored pairings.

entities.label: USB-C wired link
entities.summary: USB-C data and charging; haptics and adaptive triggers are guaranteed over a wired connection.

entities.label: Charging
entities.summary: Charge over USB-C or the bottom charging contacts in a dock.

entities.label: Pairing
entities.summary: Hold PS + Create to enter Bluetooth pairing; up to four controllers can be paired to one console.

entities.label: Hardware reset
entities.summary: Pinhole reset next to the SONY logo on the rear, held for at least five seconds.

entities.label: 6-axis IMU
entities.summary: Combined 3-axis accelerometer and 3-axis gyroscope on the main PCB.

entities.label: Capacitive touch digitizer
entities.summary: Two-point projected-capacitance grid under the touchpad, with click detection.

entities.label: Trigger position sensor
entities.summary: Reports continuous trigger travel to the console; exact encoder type is not public.

entities.label: MEMS microphone
entities.summary: Miniature MEMS pressure transducer; two are used in the array.

entities.label: Stick potentiometer
entities.summary: One potentiometer per stick axis, converting gimbal angle to an analog voltage.

entities.label: Voice-coil actuator
entities.summary: Linear motor with a moving coil in a magnetic field, capable of fast, wide-band vibration.

entities.label: Adaptive trigger motor
entities.summary: Small DC rotary motor driving the trigger stopper through a gear train.

entities.label: Speaker driver
entities.summary: Moving-coil loudspeaker behind the nine-hole grille.

entities.label: LED emitter
entities.summary: RGB and white LEDs behind diffusers for the light bar, player indicator and mute state.

entities.label: Bluetooth 5.1 interface
entities.summary: 2.4 GHz Bluetooth 5.1 link carrying HID input, output reports and haptic/trigger data.

entities.label: USB Type-C interface
entities.summary: USB-C for charging and wired data; 5 V / 1.5 A charging input.

entities.label: 3.5 mm CTIA jack
entities.summary: Four-conductor TRRS jack: left, right, ground and microphone.

entities.label: Charging dock contacts
entities.summary: Bottom-edge contacts used by the DualSense charging station.

entities.label: HID input protocol
entities.summary: Standard human-interface-device report stream carrying buttons, axes, touch, motion and trigger positions.

entities.label: Lofted two-tone shell
entities.summary: Closed solid built by lofting the plan silhouette through rounded top and bottom rims. Top surface is the face plane; depth grows toward the grips. Faces are assigned to the front or rear shell by height.

entities.label: Extruded rounded plate
entities.summary: Planar outline extruded a small distance with a bevel; used for the touchpad, core plate, labels and button caps.

entities.label: Lathed stick cap
entities.summary: Surface of revolution from a 2D profile: a dished thumb surface with a raised knurled rim.

entities.label: Rounded key extrusion
entities.summary: Extruded rounded key cap with a bevel and optional directional arrow; used for the d-pad keys and system buttons.

entities.label: Swept trigger paddle
entities.summary: Trigger paddle represented as a rounded, rotated volume; the real part is a swept shell around a metal pivot.

entities.label: Rounded bar
entities.summary: Superellipse-plan bar extruded in z; used for light-bar diffusers, LEDs, mute pill and bumpers.

entities.label: Perforation array
entities.summary: Array of small circular holes / dark apertures used for the speaker grille.

entities.label: Rounded slot / port aperture
entities.summary: Rounded-rectangle aperture used for USB-C and the reset pinhole.

entities.label: Body silhouette
entities.summary: Half-outline of the face, mirrored across the centreline and smoothed as a closed Catmull-Rom curve. Traced from a calibrated 160 mm front photograph; the width envelope matches Sony's published 160 mm.

params.note: Half outline runs from top centre (0,0) clockwise to the bottom-centre notch (0,59). Mirror for the left half.

entities.label: Shell cross-section
entities.summary: Rounded top and bottom rims connecting the face plane to the rear shell; inset rims produce the soft edge highlight.

entities.label: Touchpad superellipse
entities.summary: Superellipse with exponent 4.2, 61 x 27 mm, giving the touchpad its soft-rectangular corners.

entities.label: Stick cap dish profile
entities.summary: Concave thumb dish, 19 mm rim diameter, about 2 mm deep, with a raised textured rim.

entities.label: Trigger stopper cam
entities.summary: Cam/lever profile that converts motor rotation into a resistance force against the trigger path.

entities.label: Grip outer arc
entities.summary: The long outer arc from the widest point at y~74 to the rounded grip tip at y~106.

entities.label: Satin white shell plastic
entities.summary: Matte white injection-moulded outer shell; the launch colourway's signature surface.

entities.label: Black rear shell plastic
entities.summary: Black lower shell; carries the grip microtexture and the specification label.

entities.label: Gloss black core plastic
entities.summary: Gloss black core plate and button caps; the dark centre of the two-tone face.

entities.label: Touchpad white plastic
entities.summary: Low-gloss, micro-textured touch surface (white on the launch colourway).

entities.label: Stick rubber (TPE)
entities.summary: Textured rubber overmould on the analog stick caps.

entities.label: Smoke translucent plastic
entities.summary: Clear/smoke button caps that reveal white symbols underneath.

entities.label: White LED diffuser
entities.summary: Translucent white diffuser for the player LEDs.

entities.label: RGB light guide
entities.summary: Clear polycarbonate light guide, emissive when lit. Cyan is the default atlas glow, not a fixed product colour.

entities.label: Bright metal trim
entities.summary: Thin bright trim and metal pivot parts; decorative chrome-like finish.

entities.label: Gold-plated contact
entities.summary: Gold plating on charging contacts and test pads.

entities.label: FR-4 PCB
entities.summary: Glass-reinforced epoxy printed circuit board.

entities.label: Li-ion pouch
entities.summary: Aluminium-laminate pouch cell.

entities.label: Label stock
entities.summary: Printed synthetic label with regulatory marks and barcode.

entities.label: Steel fastener
entities.summary: Phillips steel screw, PH0.

entities.label: Recess black
entities.summary: Deep recess / aperture black used for holes and slots.

entities.label: Copper voice coil
entities.summary: Copper winding and motor internals.

entities.label: Speaker cone / mesh
entities.summary: Speaker driver and protective mesh.

entities.label: D-pad key plastic
entities.summary: Glossy dark key caps with a slightly lighter edge than the recess.

entities.label: Stick rim polymer
entities.summary: Moulded textured rim around the stick cap.

entities.label: Satin
entities.summary: Low-sheen moulded finish with a soft highlight along rounded edges.

entities.label: Gloss
entities.summary: High-gloss black core and button finish.

entities.label: Microtexture
entities.summary: Moulded PlayStation-symbol microtexture across the grips; about 40,000 symbols, largest about 0.5 mm.

entities.label: Laser etching
entities.summary: Laser-etched symbols and legends on button caps.

entities.label: Pad printing
entities.summary: Pad-printed white legends on dark parts and label artwork.

entities.label: Arctic White
entities.summary: Launch shell white.

entities.label: Midnight Black
entities.summary: Black shell and core.

entities.label: Cosmic Red
entities.summary: Deep red shell.

entities.label: Cobalt Blue
entities.summary: Blue shell.

entities.label: Overall width
entities.summary: Widest lateral envelope, grip outer face to grip outer face. Annotation drawn on the face view.

entities.label: Front height
entities.summary: Top edge to bottom of grips in front elevation. Sony labels this axis 'depth'; physically it is the face-on height.

entities.label: Thickness
entities.summary: Face plane to the rear of the grips. Sony labels this axis 'height'.

entities.label: Touchpad width
entities.summary: Active capacitive width, photogrammetrically estimated.

entities.label: Stick spacing
entities.summary: Centre-to-centre distance between the two stick caps.

entities.label: Face button pitch
entities.summary: Centre-to-centre distance between adjacent face buttons.

entities.label: D-pad span
entities.summary: Overall width and height of the d-pad cluster.

entities.label: Battery capacity
entities.summary: LIP1708 cell capacity; 3.65 V nominal, about 5.7 Wh.

entities.label: Trigger travel
entities.summary: Fingertip travel of L2/R2; approximately 25-35 degrees of rotation.

entities.label: Mass
entities.summary: Approximate controller mass.

entities.label: PS button diameter
entities.summary: Photogrammetric estimate.

entities.label: Light-bar strip
entities.summary: Each of the two diffuser strips flanking the touchpad.

entities.label: Power state
entities.summary: Off, on, or standby. The PS button wakes the console; the light bar indicates the active player colour.

entities.label: Charging state
entities.summary: Charging over USB-C or the dock; the light bar pulses to indicate charging.

entities.label: Pairing state
entities.summary: Bluetooth discovery entered by holding PS + Create; player LEDs show the assigned slot.

entities.label: Mute state
entities.summary: Hardware microphone mute on/off, with an amber LED when muted.

entities.label: Trigger resistance state
entities.summary: The programmable resistance curve currently commanded by the game for each adaptive trigger.

entities.label: Press
entities.summary: Short digital actuation of a button, 0.8-1.2 mm travel.

entities.label: Hold
entities.summary: Sustained press, e.g. PS + Create for pairing or the rear reset for five seconds.

entities.label: Pull trigger
entities.summary: Analog squeeze of L2/R2 through a programmable resistance curve.

entities.summary: Motion input read by the 6-axis IMU.

entities.summary: One- or two-finger absolute touch on the capacitive pad.

entities.label: Pair
